purpose: Approved grocery inspiration artwork for the Groceries category
sharedDirection: Square photorealistic commercial supermarket still lifes on a pale icy-blue seamless tabletop and background. Soft bright studio daylight, slightly elevated three-quarter front view, tightly grouped realistic grocery ingredients with a modest finished serving in front. Keep important subjects centered for a 1.28:1 crop. Restrained packaging, no people, price tags, gift cards, UI, captions, or watermarks. Meal inspiration rather than a guaranteed bundle or exact-price shopping list.
